orientation: portrait page laid across the table, a quarter turn clockwise (its top edge to the right): its Y is the table's X
aim_rule: every page is aligned on its own, at its own three points (pages[].aim, aim_points, aim_patches); without the crosses a page keeps them only when its corner patches cannot be aimed at (one strip, or no visible patch in a corner)
table_mm_note: table_mm: from the sheet's top left corner as it lies on the table, x to the right, y down

REACH_MM.source: X-Rite i1iO 3 product page; Northlight Images review of the first i1iO. Not published for the i1iO 2, and the recordings only spanned 263 x 154 mm between aimed corners: the tester must confirm the arm reaches all three marks

SCAN_READING_INTERVAL_S.source: i1pro2_side RESULTS 6.1 (every trigger of both recordings)

SCAN_SAFE_READINGS.source: ours: about 1.5 x the fastest recorded pass

SCAN_GAP_MM.source: ours: X-Rite's supported-targets note; i1Profiler's 20 % gap limit

SPACER_MODE.source: ours: the contrast-maximising spacers ChromIQ prints for handheld strips

ROW_GAP_MM.source: ours: aperture 4.5 mm in an 8 mm row; arm accuracy unpublished

GAP_MAX_FRACTION.source: i1Profiler driver: 'gaps size too large (more than 20% of the patch length)'

PATCH_ACROSS_MM.source: ours: aperture plus 1.75 mm each side

LABEL_SIZE_MM.source: ours: the smallest size that still reads well in print

LABEL_MAX_MM.source: ours: the narrowest strip pitch (7 mm) less 1 mm

LABEL_CLEAR_MM.source: ours: aperture 4.5 mm in an 8 mm row, plus 1 mm

NUMBERS_EDGE_MM.source: ours: past every printer edge ChromIQ knows, inside the 20 mm side band

LABEL_TURN_DEG.source: ours: the sheet lies a quarter turn clockwise

RUN_EDGE_MM.source: ours: so a run never starts on the paper edge

MARK_INSET_MM.source: ours: the cross stays 8 mm from the paper edge, clear of the widest unprintable edge seen (6.4 mm, a Canon PRO-300 description, on screen 2026-11-13)

MARK_LINE_MM.source: ours: thin enough to put the sight's cross hair on

MARK_FRAME_MM.source: ours: makes the cross easy to find

BAND_MM.source: ours: mark inset 11 + half the cross 3 + 1 mm clear

PRINTER_EDGE_MM.source: the engine's default page margin for text (text_edge); the hold and the ring: unknown

AIM_CROSSES.source: ours: easier and safer to aim at than a patch

CORNER_MAX_L.source: ours: clearly darker than paper (L* about 95)

CORNER_NEVER_L.source: ours: near white is not aimed at

TEXT_MIN_CAP_MM.source: ours: 6 pt type, still legible in print

TEXT_EDGE_MM.source: ours: = NUMBERS_EDGE_MM, past every printer edge ChromIQ knows

LETTER_EDGE_MM.source: ours: the engine's own text edge

LETTER_AUTO_MM.source: ours: the engine's automatic label size, 4.9 mm

MARK_SIDE_MM.source: ours: mark inset 11 + half the cross 3 + 1 clear
